content.text:
I built an open-source Typeform alternative.

Meet Openform: conversational forms, a visual builder, themes, and CSV exports.

MIT licensed. Self-host it. Make it yours.

Try the browser demo:
https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=openform_launch&utm_content=draft_1

media.altText: Openform launch film. Animated demonstrations of the editor, one-question-at-a-time forms, responses, CSV export, and MIT-licensed source.
